genre.product-launch: Announces a product, feature or release. Hype structure: hook, reveal, benefits, CTA.
genre.product-demo: Shows a product being used: UI walkthroughs, before/after, feature tours.
genre.explainer: Teaches one idea step by step with diagrams, labels and narration.
genre.documentary: Narrated non-fiction about real events, people or places; archival or illustrated look, calm pacing.
genre.story-narrative: Tells a story with characters, tension and a payoff (Reddit stories, fables, case stories).
genre.listicle: Numbered facts, tips or rankings ('5 things...').
genre.data-story: Numbers and charts carry the narrative: counters, bars, maps of values.
genre.map-journey: Geography-driven: routes, borders, zooms between places, territorial change.
genre.timeline: Events ordered in time: eras, milestones, history of X.
genre.quote-kinetic: A quote, statement or hook rendered as animated typography.
genre.showreel: Fast montage / sizzle reel showing range rather than one message.
genre.comparison: A versus B: side-by-side, scale ladders, pros and cons.
genre.tutorial: How-to: numbered steps the viewer can follow.
genre.news-recap: Short recap of current events or updates with headlines and sources.
genre.meme-reaction: Humor format: meme templates, reaction cuts, punchlines.
genre.music-visual: Visuals driven by audio: beat-synced motion, visualizers, lyric videos.

domain.history: The past: civilizations, wars, inventions, historical figures.
domain.geography: Countries, cities, borders, maps, travel, demographics.
domain.science: Physics, chemistry, biology, how things work.
domain.health: Fitness, nutrition, medicine, mental health (no medical advice).
domain.culture-entertainment: Film, music, games, celebrities, internet culture.
domain.education: Learning, language, study skills, general knowledge.
domain.generic: Works for any subject; the content carries the domain.

adWeave.native-integrated: The user's product IS the subject or appears inside the story naturally (direct campaigns).
adWeave.end-card: The video stays fully on-topic; a branded end card closes it.
adWeave.mid-roll-card: A short sponsor card interrupts once near the middle, then the topic resumes.
adWeave.sponsor-mention: A one-line 'brought to you by' lower third or caption; no visual takeover.
adWeave.none-pure-brand: No product placement (control items, pure audience building).

technique.kinetic-type: Animated typography is the main visual.
technique.maps: Map shapes, routes or geographic projections.
technique.charts: Bar, line, pie or counter visualizations.
technique.stock-footage: Uses user-supplied or imported video/image assets per scene.
technique.transitions: Scene-to-scene transitions are a key part of the look.

tier.fill: Fill tier: a model only returns JSON props that validate against the entry's schema. Works with small/local models and unattended background jobs.
tier.fork: Fork tier: an agent with file tools copies the entry and edits the code. Requires a frontier coding agent.

minModel.small: 7-14B local models can fill the props reliably.
minModel.mid: Needs a mid-size model (30B+ / fast hosted model) to fill props well.
minModel.frontier: Needs a frontier model (Claude / GPT class) to use well.

renderCost.low: Under ~1 minute of render per 30 s of video on a laptop.
renderCost.high: More than 3 minutes per 30 s (3D, heavy effects).

requires.voiceover: Narration audio (local Kokoro TTS or user audio).
requires.user-images: One image/video asset per scene supplied by the user or imported.
requires.llm.structured: A structured-output model must prepare a spec before render.
requires.music: A music track improves the result.

roles.hook: Opens the video and earns the next 3 seconds: a striking image, claim, question or punchline.
roles.context: Sets the scene or tells the story: who, where, when, what happened.
roles.evidence: Shows proof with data, a comparison, a map or a timeline.
roles.explanation: Shows how something works: steps, a process, a mechanism.
roles.payoff: Delivers the takeaways: facts, a list, a ranking.
roles.closer: Ends the video: a memorable line, the lesson, or the call to action.

look.adaptive: Brightness comes from a palette/theme prop.
